name: Cats Organized Neatly 2
detailed_description:
The cats are back – and they’re moodier than ever!


In Cats Organized Neatly 2, the cozy puzzle fun returns with even more adorable feline friends to arrange just right. Rotate and place each quirky kitty onto the board – but this time, it’s not just about fitting them in… it’s about understanding what makes them purr.

Some love basking in sunny spots, while others want to stay close to their kitten crew. Every cat has its own little personality – and it’s up to you to make them all feel right at home.

KEY FEATURES

  • 🐈Cats
    30 unique, hand-drawn cats – each with their own shapes and cuteness overload.
  • 🧩Handcrafted Levels
    The games come with 80 handcrafted levels, designed to gently challenge your brain and warm your heart.
  • 🌞New Cat Personalities
    Some crave sunny spots, others want to cuddle up with their kitten pals, and others are grumpy from time to time. It's not just a puzzle – it’s feline matchmaking.
  • 🎵Soothing Soundtrack
    Cats Organized Neatly has relaxing background music, resembling the atmosphere of a Cat Café. Sit down and pet some cats.
